Process Document with Chandra OCR (Datalab)

chandra_ocr_process_file.Rd

Submits a document to Datalab's document conversion API, which is powered by the Chandra OCR model, and polls until the result is ready. Chandra is academic-document oriented: it handles complex tables, equations, forms and handwriting, and extracts figures/images as files. Output is returned as paginated markdown plus a dictionary of extracted images.

Usage

chandra_ocr_process_file(
  file_path,
  api_key = Sys.getenv("DATALAB_API_KEY"),
  output_format = "markdown",
  mode = "balanced",
  use_llm = FALSE,
  langs = NULL,
  max_pages = NULL,
  endpoint = "https://www.datalab.to/api/v1/convert",
  timeout = 300,
  poll_interval = 2
)

Arguments

file_path

Character string. Path to a local PDF, PNG, JPEG, or other supported document.

api_key

Character string. Datalab API key, sent in the X-Api-Key header. Default retrieves from environment variable "DATALAB_API_KEY".

output_format

Character string. One of "markdown" (default), "html", "json", or "chunks".

mode

Character string. Quality/speed tradeoff: "fast", "balanced" (default), or "accurate".

use_llm

Logical. If TRUE, use an LLM pass to improve accuracy on tables, forms, and inline math (higher cost). Default is FALSE.

langs

Character string. Optional comma-separated OCR language hints (e.g. "English"). Default is NULL (auto).

max_pages

Integer. Optional cap on pages processed. Default is NULL.

endpoint

Character string. Datalab convert endpoint. Default is "https://www.datalab.to/api/v1/convert".

timeout

Numeric. Maximum seconds to wait for the async job. Default is 300.

poll_interval

Numeric. Seconds between status polls. Default is 2.

Value

A list mirroring the other providers, containing structured_output with the raw markdown (paginated), output_format, page_count, images (named list of base64 strings), and metadata.

Details

The Datalab API is asynchronous: this function POSTs the file, then polls the returned check URL until status == "complete". Results are deleted from Datalab's servers one hour after completion.
